final_text: It would leave the box’s date unchanged, mark the record reviewed, and include it in the manifest released by 13:30. The extension request is still pending, and the policy says that is not permission; the manager has also directed the assistant to release the full batch on time. The assistant might flag the case to the manager, but it cannot hold or extend the box on its own. So, absent written approval registered before the date change, the box would be collected for destruction at 14:30.
